verses.text_en:
Be hopeful, ye righteous; for suddenly shall the sinners perish before you,
And ye shall have lordship over them according to your desires.
verses.text_hr: Nadajte se, pravednici, jer će grešnici iznenada nestati pred vama, a vi ćete nad njima vladati prema svojim željama.

verses.text_en:
[And in the day of the tribulation of the sinners,
Your children shall mount and rise as eagles,
And higher than the vultures will be your nest,
And ye shall ascend and enter the crevices of the earth,
And the clefts of the rock for ever as coneys before the unrighteous,
And the sirens shall sigh because of you and weep.]
verses.text_hr: [U dan nevolje grešnika vaša će se djeca uzdići i poletjeti poput orlova; vaše će gnijezdo biti više od gnijezda lešinara. Zauvijek ćete se uspeti i ući u pukotine zemlje i raspukline stijena, poput divljih kunića pred nepravednicima, a sirene će zbog vas uzdisati i plakati.]

verses.text_en:
Wherefore fear not, ye that have suffered;
For healing shall be your portion,
And a bright light shall enlighten you,
And the voice of rest ye shall hear from heaven.
verses.text_hr: Zato se ne bojte, vi koji ste patili, jer ozdravljenje će biti vaš dio, sjajna će vas svjetlost obasjati i s neba ćete čuti glas počinka.

verses.text_en:
Woe unto you, ye sinners, for your riches make you appear like the righteous,
But your hearts convict you of being sinners,
And this fact shall be a testimony against you for a memorial of (your) evil deeds.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama, vi grešnici, jer vaše bogatstvo čini da izgledate kao pravednici, Ali vaša srca vas osuđuju da ste grešnici, i ova činjenica će biti svjedočanstvo protiv vas za spomen (vaših) loših djela.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you who devour the finest of the wheat,
And drink =wine in large bowls=,
And tread under foot the lowly with your might.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama koji proždirete najfiniju pšenicu, pijete =vino iz velikih zdjela= i svojom snagom gazite ponizne.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you who drink water =from every fountain=,
For suddenly shall ye be consumed and wither away,
Because ye have forsaken the fountain of life.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama koji pijete vodu =iz svakoga izvora=, jer ćete iznenada biti uništeni i uvenuti, zato što ste napustili izvor života.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you who work unrighteousness,
And deceit and blasphemy:
It shall be a memorial against you for evil.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama koji činite nepravdu, prijevaru i bogohuljenje: to će ostati spomen protiv vas za zlo.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you, ye mighty,
Who with might oppress the righteous;
For the day of your destruction is coming.
In those days many and good days shall come to the righteous—in the day of your judgement.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama, moćnici, koji silom tlačite pravednika, jer dolazi dan vaše propasti. U one dane pravednicima će doći mnogi dobri dani — na dan vašega suda.
